meta.description: 使用 OpenAlex 与 AnySearch 两个真实数据源并行搜索、交叉匹配和输出可追溯论文元数据。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行搜索学术论文并交叉匹配元数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多个学术数据源查找和比对论文信息
copy.tagline_en: Search academic papers in parallel and cross-match metadata
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and compare paper metadata from multiple academic sources

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会同时用 OpenAlex 和 AnySearch 两个学术数据库搜索论文，自动交叉验证 DOI 或标题相似的记录，合并重复项，并按相关性排序输出可追溯的论文元数据。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索学术论文、查找参考文献或询问某个研究主题的文献时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索关于“鲁棒优化车辆路径”的论文
say.note: 会并行搜索两个引擎并输出交叉验证结果。

say.text: 找一下“层次分析法”的文献，只要8篇
say.note: 指定数量，结果会按相关性排序。
物理材料类查询，组合关键词提高准确度。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will search both OpenAlex and AnySearch academic databases in parallel, automatically cross-validate records with matching DOIs or similar titles, merge duplicates, and output traceable paper metadata sorted by relevance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search for academic papers, find references, or inquire about literature on a research topic.

say_en.text: Search for papers on 'robust optimization vehicle routing'.
Find literature on 'analytic hierarchy process', limit to 8.
say_en.note: Specifies result count; results sorted by relevance.
Physics/materials query with combined keywords for better accuracy.
